publisher_document_contract.private_app_store: No app .beads path is opened or written. Every changed path is exactly allowlisted, full unrelated stage-0 entries remain equal, and normal FF under unchanged config touches only the reviewed documents and Git metadata. This is preservation by restricted operations, not a full private app database byte audit.
publisher_document_contract.hooks: Fresh effective hook.* configuration must be absent; effective filesystem hook list must equal the reviewed accepted_hooks. The observed empty list may be used only after fresh verification; no hook suppression.
publisher_document_contract.normal_git: Explicit immutable HTTPS fork fetch with --no-tags --no-write-fetch-head --no-recurse-submodules --no-auto-maintenance --no-write-commit-graph; ancestor check; merge --ff-only; optional ordinary push if remote is still expected_head. Command-local gc.auto=0, maintenance.auto=false and pack.threads=1. No persistent config changes.
publisher_document_contract.working_bytes: Bind canonical LF bytes/SHA/Git blob and actual built-in cat-file --filters bytes/SHA independently under unchanged core.autocrlf=true. All document attributes remain inspected; external filter/encoding/ident transformations are refused.
publisher_document_contract.reviews_rule: All reviews[] paths must be strictly under C or R and hash-pinned; 1..8 entries, accepted status passed or PASS, and no open_findings. Before R exists, use C. Fill real installed/configured/text acceptance, not a failed configured result or draft-only acceptance.

retention_rule: Keep C, the baseline raw index, all direct and indirect predecessor outputs, failed attempt records and successful source retention through final-restore and final publication acceptance. Do not replay occupied attempts after interruption.
